resources.name: ParlayAPI (curated)
resources.description: ParlayAPI: real-time sports odds API. 30+ sportsbooks and data sources, player props, arbitrage and +EV tools, prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket), historical closing lines from 2005. Drop-in compatible with the-odds-api (same endpoint shapes, /v4 paths, ?apiKey= auth). Free tier: 1,000 credits a month, no card required. Docs: https://parlay-api.com/docs

resources.name: Kelly stake calculator
resources.description: Keyless and free. Kelly criterion stake sizing. odds accepts American (120, -110) or decimal (2.20). fraction=0.25 is quarter Kelly.

resources.name: Edge calculator
resources.description: Keyless and free. Expected value of a bet given your estimated true win probability. Alternative mode: pass sharp_over_odds and sharp_under_odds instead of true_prob to devig a sharp book's two-sided price.

resources.name: Hedge calculator
resources.description: Keyless and free. How much to stake on the other side to lock in equal profit (target=equal_profit) or guarantee break-even (target=break_even).

resources.name: Free bet conversion calculator
resources.description: Keyless and free. Optimal hedge for converting a free bet or bonus bet into withdrawable cash, with the conversion rate.

resources.name: Credit costs per endpoint
resources.description: Keyless and free. Exact credit price of every endpoint, including the formula for variable-cost endpoints (markets x regions). Every paid response also carries an x-requests-last header with the exact charge.

resources.name: API info and discovery

resources.name: Search prediction markets
resources.description: Keyless and free. Search event markets across Kalshi, Polymarket, and Novig by keyword. Add sources=kalshi to filter, min_volume to cut thin markets.

resources.name: MCP: initialize
resources.description: MCP streamable HTTP endpoint hosted by ParlayAPI. Remote-capable MCP clients (claude.ai connectors, hosted agents) normally do this handshake for you: just point them at https://parlay-api.com/mcp/http. Keyless requests get the discovery and signup tools; add Authorization: Bearer <api_key> for the full set. Some deployments require the Mcp-Session-Id response header from initialize to be echoed on later calls. If this request returns 404 the remote transport is not deployed yet: install the local server instead with: uvx parlayapi-mcp (source: https://github.com/JacobiusMakes/parlay-api-mcp).

resources.description: Optional metered request. Requires a key with player-props access. Compare matching events, players, market periods and lines. For legacy flat-payout DFS rows, midpoint prices are normalized comparison values. A source can be absent and a 25-row page can be incomplete.
